newsitem.title: HAITI: U.S. congressmen assess Haiti problems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. congressmen assess Haiti problems.

text.p: Two Republican U.S. lawmakers arrived in Port-au-Prince on Friday to assess progress and problems in justice, law enforcement and security in Haiti, the U.S. Embassy said.

Sen. Michael DeWine of Ohio and Representative Porter Goss of Florida, both of whom serve on the Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence, will meet President Rene Preval and Prime Minister Rony Smart to discuss development, economy and security, embassy spokeswoman Meg Gilroy said.

White House policy toward Haiti has come under fire by Republicans, most notably by defeated presidential candidate Bob Dole, who claim Haiti's government is involved in politically motivated killings.
